- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Lines 12 (new bullet) and 187 (cleanup header) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The issue-mode zombie-checker cleanup trigger is placed under Step 0 but depends on the Source issue: identifier parsed from the plan in Step 1, and no operational instruction invokes the cleanup after Step 1.
  WHY: An unattended session will attempt cleanup before the identifier is available, causing label checks to fail or be skipped and leaving stopped sessions unarchived.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Lines 103, 108, 161 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: No defined error-handling path exists if set_session_title (rename) or mcp__github__issue_read (label read) fails transiently.
  WHY: Rename failures can leave the session with an unmatched title, and transient label-read failures can skip archival without reporting to the operator.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:line 107 (Stops bullet), rename-failure parenthetical | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The rename-failure fallback does not name the tool to edit the existing blocker comment, leaving it unclear how to add the stopped session id without reposting the comment or losing the fallback signal.
  WHY: If set_session_title fails twice, the cleanup needs the session id in the issue thread, but the fallback depends on the session interpreting how to update the comment.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:line 187 (Zombie-checker cleanup section header) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup-section header leads with “Every stage session runs this in step 0” even though issue-mode resume defers cleanup until after Step 1 reads the plan.
  WHY: An unattended session or future maintainer may follow the leading wording and attempt cleanup before the Source issue: identifier is known, or skip cleanup.
